sys_pd_process_definition.description: BCFA AP invoice journey: intake, simulated extraction (POC), validation, PO/GRN-SRN 3-way match, exceptions, approval, MOCK SAP posting, closure. A view of the authoritative state only.
sys_pd_process_definition.label: BCFA AP Invoice Processing Playbook
sys_pd_process_definition.name: bcfa_ap_invoice_processing

sys_pd_lane.description: Invoice received by email, upload or manual entry and registered with a correlation ID.
sys_pd_lane.label: 1. Invoice Intake
sys_pd_lane.name: intake

sys_pd_lane.description: SIMULATED DOCUMENT EXTRACTION — POC. Header and line fields extracted from the invoice document; low confidence or missing fields go to a person.
sys_pd_lane.label: 2. Document Extraction
sys_pd_lane.name: extraction

sys_pd_lane.description: Mandatory fields, vendor, company, PO, currency, duplicate and tax controls by the rules engine.
sys_pd_lane.label: 3. Validation & Enrichment
sys_pd_lane.name: validation

sys_pd_lane.description: Deterministic 3-way match of invoice, PO and goods / service receipt within the configured tolerances. AI never overrides a tolerance.
sys_pd_lane.label: 4. PO / GRN-SRN / 3-Way Match
sys_pd_lane.name: matching

sys_pd_lane.description: Runs alongside stages 2-4 and completes when no exception is open. System determination, AI recommendation and human decision are kept separate.
sys_pd_lane.label: 5. Exception Resolution
sys_pd_lane.name: exception

sys_pd_lane.description: Human approval within the delegation of authority; ApprovalEngine and segregation of duties are authoritative.
sys_pd_lane.label: 6. Approval
sys_pd_lane.name: approval

sys_pd_lane.description: MOCK SAP. Idempotent posting through IntegrationService; an unknown outcome is reconciled by a status query, never blind-retried.
sys_pd_lane.label: 7. SAP Posting (Mock SAP)
sys_pd_lane.name: posting

sys_pd_lane.description: Reconciled and closed; full evidence and audit trail of system, AI and human actions.
sys_pd_lane.label: 8. Closure & Audit
sys_pd_lane.name: closure

sys_variable_value.value: SYSTEM DETERMINATION is the rule result; AI RECOMMENDATION is advisory (Explain Exception, Recommended Next Action, Draft Clarification); HUMAN DECISION is recorded by the authorised person. Only a person resolves; AI never approves or overrides tolerance.
Waiting for the open exceptions to be resolved by their owners.
The invoice is reconciled and closed (or rejected by a person). Closure cannot happen while an UNKNOWN_OUTCOME is unresolved. The audit trail records every system, AI and human action.
Waiting for extraction, or for a person to review a low-confidence / missing-field exception.

Fields were read by the POC extraction simulation (native Document Intelligence is not active on this instance). Low confidence or a missing mandatory field raises an exception: the stage does not complete until a person resolves it.
Approval is a HUMAN DECISION by an authorised approver. The requester and the processor cannot approve (SoD check recorded on the approval). AI cannot approve.
Waiting for validation, or for a person to resolve a failed control (duplicate, vendor, PO, tax).
Vendor master, company, PO reference, currency, duplicate and tax controls evaluated by the system. A failed control raises an exception and the stage stays open.
Waiting for the MOCK SAP posting result or for reconciliation of an unknown outcome.

The approved invoice is posted by IntegrationService to MOCK SAP (no real SAP connection in the POC). The Playbook never calls SAP. An UNKNOWN_OUTCOME stays here until reconciliation confirms the result.
Waiting for the invoice to be registered and sent for extraction.
The invoice document was received and registered (intake record, attachment and correlation ID).
Waiting for the match, or for a person to resolve a quantity, price, receipt or line-total exception.
MatchingEngine compared each invoice line with its PO line and receipt. Variances and the result below are the engine's own record; the Playbook does not recalculate them.
FAILED validation controls with evidence (none listed = all controls PASSED)
HUMAN DECISION: approval requests, decisions and SoD checks
MATCH RESULT (MatchingEngine): PO line vs GRN/SRN vs invoice, variances and tolerance verdict
Exceptions: SYSTEM DETERMINATION (rule result, variance) | AI RECOMMENDATION (advisory) | HUMAN DECISION
Intake: source document, channel and status (open a row for the attachment)
MOCK SAP integration transactions: adapter, idempotency key, status, document, reconciliation
SIMULATED DOCUMENT EXTRACTION — POC: extraction result and review
AI assistance used on this invoice (advisory)
AI RECOMMENDATION — advisory only (Now Assist): never approves, posts or overrides tolerance
SUPPLIER INVOICE lines with their PO line and receipt
